fxeasy.bonus.body: Trade ten pairs of five currencies, 1x to 100x, on a market the world itself prices.
fxeasy.bonus.note: One per account, liquidation at 50%, only you can claim it
fxeasy.bonus.title: Your welcome capital has landed
fxeasy.checkout.subtitle: %s · %s game days a period
fxeasy.checkout.title: Checkout
fxeasy.confirm.close_all.body: %s positions close at the current price and cannot be restored
fxeasy.confirm.close_all.title: Close every position?
fxeasy.confirm.deposit.body: %s %s leaves your inventory and backs your positions
fxeasy.confirm.deposit.title: Deposit?
fxeasy.confirm.withdraw.body: %s %s leaves the account and returns to your inventory
fxeasy.confirm.withdraw.title: Withdraw?
fxeasy.event.allay_receipt_mixup.body: The accounting system clarifies that allays only move items: a transfer is not supply.
fxeasy.event.allay_receipt_mixup.title: Allay receipt mixup
fxeasy.event.barter_boom.body: Completed piglin barters kept running high, which is a real use of gold rather than a new issue.
fxeasy.event.barter_boom.title: Barter activity report
fxeasy.event.boss_confidence.body: A reviewed boss milestone was reached. This is a report only: real gear spending is observed separately.
fxeasy.event.boss_confidence.title: Boss milestone
fxeasy.event.cleric_forecast.body: An entertainment forecast is out. The recap will compare it with what the prices actually did.
fxeasy.event.cleric_forecast.title: Cleric forecast
fxeasy.event.creeper_press_release.body: A short press release. It ended sooner than expected and the reporters suggest keeping your distance.
fxeasy.event.creeper_press_release.title: Creeper press release
fxeasy.event.diamond_mining_boom.body: Supported natural ore sources delivered diamonds above capacity for at least two buckets, which is the supply side of the diamond.
fxeasy.event.diamond_mining_boom.title: Diamond mining report
fxeasy.event.dimension_expansion.body: A first major step into a new dimension raises the expected future supply of its resources, which presses on netherite and diamonds until real output replaces the estimate.
fxeasy.event.dimension_expansion.title: Dimension expansion
fxeasy.event.dragon_unlock.body: The ender dragon was killed for the first time in this world. Exploration and gear in the End are expected, so diamonds and netherite see small demand.
fxeasy.event.dragon_unlock.title: End route unlocked
fxeasy.event.emerald_trade_issuance.body: Emeralds villagers actually paid out stayed above the capacity threshold. Issuance expands the supply, so the pressure is on the emerald.
fxeasy.event.end_shipping_delay.body: A shipping message from the End, with the repair progress to follow. An unconfirmed delay expires on its own.
fxeasy.event.end_shipping_delay.title: End shipping delay
fxeasy.event.gold_industrial_output.body: Supported sources kept producing gold above capacity for several buckets, so the fundamental component carries the supply pressure. This report adds nothing on top of it.
fxeasy.event.gold_quality_dispute.body: A dispute about the purity of gold is priced as a small credit discount until the investigation says the ingots were fine all along.
fxeasy.event.gold_quality_dispute.title: Gold quality dispute
fxeasy.event.kurumi_margin_review.body: The group publishes its current risk figures and reminds clients to trade carefully. The risk disclosure font stays the same size.
fxeasy.event.kurumi_margin_review.title: Kurumi risk notice
fxeasy.event.netherite_resource_wave.bod: Ancient debris actually extracted, counted at a quarter of an ingot each, presses on netherite. Real smithing is observed on its own.
fxeasy.event.piglin_festival.body: The piglin guild announces a gold festival. Real barters during it decide how hot it gets, and a festival that fizzles gives the expectation back.
fxeasy.event.piglin_festival.title: Piglin gold festival
fxeasy.event.raid_disruption.body: A raid started in a level that holds a trade region with recent real trades. Trade convenience and credit are expected to suffer while it runs.
fxeasy.event.raid_disruption.title: Village trade disrupted
fxeasy.event.raid_recovery.body: The raid is over and the surviving traders are trading again, so the disruption premium is released step by step.
fxeasy.event.raid_recovery.title: Village trade recovering
fxeasy.event.reconstruction_demand.body: A recently active trade region was hit and then rebuilt with real material, which is demand for building dirt.
fxeasy.event.reconstruction_demand.title: Reconstruction demand
fxeasy.event.resource_discovery_rumor.bo: A surveyor reports a vein. The claim decays without extraction evidence and is replaced by a report once real mining shows up.
fxeasy.event.smithing_order_rumor.body: A large smithing order, published as the rumor it is. Real crafting cannot count the same demand twice.
fxeasy.event.smithing_order_rumor.title: Smithing order rumor
fxeasy.event.trade_network_damage.body: Several villagers that had recently traded died in one window, so the trade network lost part of its capacity.
fxeasy.event.trade_network_damage.title: Trade network damage
fxeasy.event.trade_reabsorption.body: Players paid emeralds back to villagers in size, which reabsorbs part of the issuance. It promises no rise: a larger issuance can still outweigh it.
fxeasy.event.trade_reabsorption.title: Emerald reabsorption
fxeasy.event.villager_trade_fair.body: A trade season is announced. Actual issuance and reabsorption decide the net direction.
fxeasy.event.villager_trade_fair.title: Villager trade fair
fxeasy.event.weather_logistics.body: Real weather over an exposed trade region raises the cost of moving goods for a while. It carries no direction of its own.
fxeasy.event.weather_logistics.title: Weather logistics
